Class RelativeLink

java.lang.Object
org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.providers.atom.CommonAttributes
org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.providers.atom.Link
org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.providers.atom.RelativeLink
public class RelativeLink extends Link
If invoked within the context of a JAX-RS call, it will automatically build a URI based the base URI of the JAX-RS application. Same URI as UriInfo.getRequestUri().
